required_tables.grain: region x age_band x sex x education_level

required_tables.coverage_note: Education base is population aged 15 and over. Align target population before combining with all-age tables.

required_tables.grain: region x age_band x sex x computer_literacy
required_tables.source_name: Census 2022 Serbia education and literacy release / dissemination database
required_tables.coverage_note: Computer literacy base is population aged 15 and over.
required_tables.comments: Use to condition digital access and online-shopping readiness.

required_tables.source_name: Statistical Office of the Republic of Serbia, Census 2022 households by number of members
required_tables.coverage_note: Household-level table. Convert carefully when assigning person-level household context.
required_tables.comments: Use for household role, family burden, and purchase-decision context.

required_tables.source_name: Statistical Office of the Republic of Serbia, Usage ICT - individuals
required_tables.coverage_note: Individual ICT survey; age base depends on SORS ICT methodology, typically individuals aged 16-74. Use as soft-trait prior unless aligned to census bands.
required_tables.comments: Use for internet use, computer use, and social-network priors.

required_tables.source_name: SORS census or labour market statistics
required_tables.coverage_note: Choose census economic activity if available for structural pack; use labour force survey for latest market context.
required_tables.comments: Required for budget pressure, time scarcity, and category need.

required_tables.source_name: SORS household budget / income and living conditions survey
required_tables.coverage_note: Income distribution may be survey-based rather than census-based.
required_tables.comments: If region x income is unavailable, use national income bands plus regional wage adjustment with uncertainty penalty.

required_tables.coverage_note: Use official settlement classification if available. Avoid generic global urban share when official table exists.
required_tables.comments: Controls channel access, digital behavior, logistics, and household context.

optional_tables.comments: Useful for category-level affordability and price-sensitivity priors.
